name: reread-guard
description: Stops Claude re-reading a file that is already in context and unchanged, so the same text is not added (and re-billed every turn) twice.

enabled.title: Block repeat reads
enabled.description: Refuse a Read of an unchanged file whose exact range is already in context. Off: reads go through and are only counted.

minChars.title: Ignore files smaller than (bytes)
minChars.description: Re-reading a tiny file costs less than the refusal message does.
